title: Configure PriorityClass and PodDisruptionBudget
prompt:
Workload `payment-api` in namespace `cka-pdb` requires eviction protection during voluntary drains and high scheduling priority.

Perform the following tasks:
1. Create PriorityClass `pc-cka-pdb-high` with value `100000` (`globalDefault: false`).
2. Update Deployment `payment-api` in namespace `cka-pdb` to use `priorityClassName: pc-cka-pdb-high` and maintain `2` ready replicas.
3. Create PodDisruptionBudget `payment-api-pdb` in namespace `cka-pdb` protecting pods with `app=payment-api` (`minAvailable: 1`).
hints: PriorityClass is cluster-scoped: `k create priorityclass pc-cka-pdb-high --value=100000`.
Use `k -n cka-pdb create pdb payment-api-pdb --selector=app=payment-api --min-available=1` and patch Deployment `priorityClassName`.

manifests:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: payment-api
  namespace: cka-pdb
spec:
  replicas: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: payment-api
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: payment-api
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: app
        image: nginx:1.27-alpine

apiVersion: scheduling.k8s.io/v1
kind: PriorityClass
metadata:
  name: pc-cka-pdb-high
value: 100000
globalDefault: false
apiVersion: policy/v1
kind: PodDisruptionBudget
metadata:
  name: payment-api-pdb
  namespace: cka-pdb
spec:
  minAvailable: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: payment-api

reference_solution: Create PriorityClass `pc-cka-pdb-high`, patch Deployment `payment-api` to reference it, and create PodDisruptionBudget `payment-api-pdb`.
